# eon_restore_account_region_aws_instance_types (Data Source)

Retrieves EC2 instance types available for restore in an AWS restore-account subnet. Use this data source to select an `instance_type` for `eon_restore_job`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "eon_restore_account_region_aws_instance_types" "destination" {
  restore_account_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  region             = "us-east-1"
  subnet_id          = "subnet-0123456789abcdef0"
  volume_count       = 2
  total_volume_bytes = 107374182400
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region` (String) AWS Region where the subnet is located.
- `restore_account_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the AWS restore account.
- `subnet_id` (String) Cloud-provider-assigned ID of the subnet whose available instance types are listed.

### Optional

- `total_volume_bytes` (Number) Total size in bytes of guest volumes planned for restore. When omitted, Eon uses its default host-memory reserve.
- `volume_count` (Number) Number of guest volumes planned for restore. When omitted, Eon uses its default host-memory reserve.

### Read-Only

- `instance_types` (List of String) List of EC2 instance types available for restore.
- `instant_restore_mapping` (Map of String) Map from post-promotion to instant-restore host instance type. Instance types absent from this map are unavailable for instant restore.
